description: The one Whispering window. Rust opens it on Whispering's AppData root, whose settings.md the page reads (openAppData from @epicenter/folder/tauri, which finds it with Tauri's path API); the page then opens its data folder by path (openDataFolder): the folder settings.md names, or ~/Epicenter/<productName> (the app's name, core:app:allow-name), which Rust allows in Tauri's runtime file-system scope at startup. Any other folder opens only once the native picker (dialog:allow-open) allowed it; persisted-scope keeps that across launches. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It records from the shell's microphone into that folder, transcribes its recordings on this computer and administers the local models, holds the global shortcut it resolved from shortcuts.md (set_shortcut) and hears its presses (core:event), signs in with Epicenter and sends the account's requests with a token it never holds, keeps its connections in the keychain, and sends requests to the endpoints the person configured (send_request).
